commentary.bulkers: The Kamsarmax "Nord Taurus" 81/2016 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 11/2026) was committed to Greek interests at USD 27,5 mill. Remind you that back in July, the "Ultra Puma" 81/2016 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 08/2026) was sold at USD 25,3 mill. Nissen Kaiun committed their Ultramax "African Cheetah" 66/2014 Mitsui, Japan (SS 03/2029, DD 04/2027, Scrubber fitted) to Bangladeshi interests at USD 24,5 mill. Note that the sister vessel "Bulk Aquila" 66/2014 Mitsui, Japan (SS 11/2029, DD 11/2027) was sold in June at USD 22,5 mill. On the Supramax sector, the "Ocean Knight" 56/2011 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 01/2026) was committed to Chinese interests at USD 12,1 mill. Note that a couple of months ago, the "APJ Jai" 56/2011 Cosco, China (SS/DD 12/2025) was sold at USD 11,25 mill. Furthermore, following the sale of the "Spar Virgo" 53/2005 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 06/2025) in May at USD 8,5 mill, Spar Shipping have now committed the sister vessel "Spar Taurus" 53/2005 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 11/2025) to Chinese interests at USD 8,8 mill. Chang Myung Shipping have committed their Handysize "CH Bella" & "CH Doris" 33/2010 Zhejiang, China (SS/DD 11/2025 both) at low USD 8 mill each, while the one-year-older sister vessel "Golden Maple" 32/2009 Zhejiang, China (SS 06/2029, DD 06/2027) of Hangang Global Shipping was committed to Vietnamese interests at USD 7,3 mill. For comparison, the sister vessel "Sea Sapphire" 32/2010 Zhejiang, China (SS 03/2030, DD 05/2028) was sold a month ago at USD 8,5 mill.
commentary.tankers: The Suezmax "Advantage Summer" 156/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 09/2025, Scrubber fitted) was committed at USD 38 mill. Remind you that the one-year-younger sister vessel "Front Brage" 156/2011 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 03/2026, Scrubber fitted) was sold a month ago at the same price. In addition, the "Ottoman Nobility" 152/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 01/2030, DD 04/2028) was committed at USD 27 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the "Kriti Vigor" 159/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 02/2030, DD 05/2028, Scrubber fitted) was sold at USD 29 mill. Polembros Shipping committed their Aframax "Patmos Warrior" 105/2007 Sumitomo, Japan (SS 10/2027, DD 02/2026) at USD 28 mill. For reference, the two-years-older sister vessel "Aqua Pearl" 105/2005 Sumitomo, Japan (SS/DD 01/2026) was sold back in July at high USD 24 mill.

freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds ranged at the usd 15,000/17,000 pd. A number of Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported fixed in the usd 14,000/17,000 pd range. Australian trips into India were reported at the level of usd 15,000/16,000 pd. South East Asian trips via South America into China were fixed around usd 13,000/14,000 pd. Indian trips via South America into China were fixed around usd 15,000/18,000 pd. Indian trips via Arabian Gulf into India were reported at the level of usd 15,000/16,000 pd. Indian trips into China were fixed around usd 16,000 pd. Inter-Continental trips via US Gulf were reported at the level of usd 18,000/21,000 pd. Continental trips via US East Coast into India or South East Asia were fixed around usd 26,000/28,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into Continent were reported at the level of usd 28,000/31,000 pd. On the period front, a Kamsarmax was reported fixed in the usd 15,500 pd for 1 year employment basis delivery China. Also, a Kamsarmax was fixed on a period at the usd 14,250 pd basis delivery China for 5/7 months employment.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: A number of Indonesian into China were reported fixed in the usd 16,000/18,000 pd range. Arabian Gulf trips into India were fixed around usd 15,000/18,000 pd. South African trips into China were reported at the level of usd 18,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 180K. Trips from Red Sea into South East Asia were fixed around usd 23,000 pd. West African trips into China were reported at the level of usd 16,000/18,000 pd. US Gulf trips into North Coast South America were fixed around usd 27,000/29,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into Mediterranean were reported at the level of usd 27,000/28,000 pd. No period activity to report here.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: Continental trips via Baltic into West Africa were reported at the level of usd 17,500/19,500 pd. East Coast South American trips into Continent were fixed around usd 22,000/23,000 pd. A large Handysize was fixed on a period at the usd 17,150 pd basis delivery East Coast South America for 4/6 months employment.
